Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting persons from holding two elected offices for which he or she receives compensation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting persons from holding two electedoffices for which he or she receives compensation; adding a new sectionto chapter 35.22 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.23 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 35.27 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter36.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.22 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who holds a city elected office for which he or shereceives compensation is prohibited from simultaneously holding anelected state or legislative office for which he or she also receivescompensation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who holds a city elected office for which he or shereceives compensation is prohibited from simultaneously holding anelected state or legislative office for which he or she also receivescompensation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who holds a town elected office for which he or shereceives compensation is prohibited from simultaneously holding anelected state or legislative office for which he or she also receivescompensation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who holds a county elected office for which he or shereceives compensation is prohibited from simultaneously holding anelected state or legislative office for which he or she also receivescompensation.
